blocks.prompt: 5. Prove that in parabola a circle described on latus rectum as diameter touches the directrix.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi proof wala sawal hai, aur kisi khaas parabola ki baat nahi ho rahi; yeh har parabola ke liye saabit karna hai.
Is liye axes aise rakhte hain ke parabola \(y^{2} = 4ax\) ban jaye; yeh hamesha mumkin hai aur is se khaasiyat badalti nahi.
Latus rectum ko diameter bana kar circle banana hai: centre us ka mid-point aur radius \(4a\) ka aadha.
Circle kisi line ko tab chhoota hai jab centre se line ka faasla radius ke barabar ho. Yahi hum dikhayenge.
Pehle zehan mein tasveer banayein: parabola daayen khulta hai, focus \(F(a, 0)\) par latus rectum seedha khara hai, aur us ke upar neeche ke siron \(L\), \(L'\) ko jor kar diameter banta hai. Is diameter par circle kheenchein to woh focus ke gird ghoomta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: parabola \(y^{2} = 4ax\); latus rectum ke ends \(L(a, 2a)\), \(L'(a, -2a)\); directrix \(x = -a\).
Saabit karna: \(LL'\) ko diameter maan kar bana circle directrix ko chhoota hai.
Tareeqa: circle ka centre aur radius, phir centre se directrix ka faasla radius se compare karna.
Yaad rakhein: latus rectum ke ends 6.3.2 mein nikle the; \(x = a\) ko \(y^{2} = 4ax\) mein rakhne se \(y = \pm 2a\).

Centre aur radius
Centre = \(LL'\) ka mid-point = \(\left(\frac{a + a}{2}, \frac{2a - 2a}{2}\right) = (a, 0)\), yaani focus \(F\) khud.
\[r = \dfrac{|LL'|}{2} = \dfrac{4a}{2} = 2a\]
Kyun: diameter ka mid-point hi circle ka centre hota hai, aur radius diameter ka aadha.

Circle ki equation
\[(x - a)^{2} + y^{2} = 4a^{2}\]
Kyun: centre \((a, 0)\) aur radius \(2a\) wala circle.

Centre se directrix ka faasla
\[d = \dfrac{|a + a|}{\sqrt{1^{2} + 0^{2}}} = 2a = r\]
Kyun: directrix \(x + a = 0\) hai; point \((a, 0)\) se faasla formula se. Seedhi nazar se bhi: \(x = a\) se \(x = -a\) tak \(2a\) ka gap hai.

Nateeja
Centre se directrix ka faasla radius ke barabar hai, is liye directrix circle ki tangent hai. Chhone ka point \(F\) se directrix par perpendicular ka paaon, yaani \((-a, 0)\) hai.
Kyun: line circle ko tab hi chhooti hai jab us ka centre se faasla radius ke barabar ho (6.2.5).
Dhyan dein: is proof mein figure banana bahut madad karta hai; circle focus ke gird bana hai aur baayen taraf bilkul directrix ko chhoota hai.

Tasdeeq:
Circle mein \(x = -a\) rakhein: \((-2a)^{2} + y^{2} = 4a^{2}\), yaani \(y^{2} = 0\), dohra root \(y = 0\). Directrix circle ko sirf ek point \((-a, 0)\) par milti hai, yahi chhona hai. (Answer key mein proof ka jawab nahi diya gaya.)
Mazedar baat: radius \(2a\) aur focus se directrix ka faasla \(2a\) hamesha barabar hote hain, chahe parabola kitna bhi chaura ya patla ho. Isi liye yeh khaasiyat har parabola mein sach hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: latus rectum par diameter wala circle centre \(F(a, 0)\) aur radius \(2a\) rakhta hai; yeh radius directrix \(x = -a\) se centre ke faasle ke barabar hai, is liye circle directrix ko \((-a, 0)\) par chhoota hai.
